newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks flat in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks flat in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were flat in the early Wednesday morning session as market participants were hunting for a firm direction, brokers said.
They added that the topside was capped by selling ahead of the end-March book closing.
As of 0013 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was 34.44 points or 0.19 percent higher at 18,302.16. Its March and June futures were both 80 points higher at 18,290 and 18,260, respectively.
"The Nikkei average gained on Tuesday, but it may be difficult to rise further," a "Big Four" broker said.
